Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry
Serves 4
Ingredients
1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced
1 tablespoon cornstarch
2 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided
4 cups broccoli florets
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated
For the sauce:
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tablespoons oyster sauce
1 tablespoon brown sugar
1 teaspoon sesame oil
1/2 cup chicken broth
2 teaspoons cornstarch
Instructions
Toss the chicken with 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, broth and cornstarch. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through, 5 to 6 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the broccoli and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce and cook until thickened, about 2 minutes. Serve over rice.
